digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM retry wire history processor
propositions: The wire history processor's request-fit check never executes on the first request because proc(messages) only descends into ModelResponse instances, and on first request the history is [ModelRequest], making _wire_keeps_response unreachable.

An oversized first request (3.6M chars against 1M token window) passes undetected through the seam with zero invocations of _wire_keeps_response, then fails at the provider with a 400 surfaced as LLMUnavailableError instead of ContextWindowExceededError.

The seam must check both request and response content using a consistent 4-chars-per-token estimator so that enrich's window*2-char bound (its maximal first-line constraint) remains admissible at ~window/2 tokens against the reserve.

A fail-closed ContextWindowExceededError raised before any provider call matches the documented error contract (request-terms: system/user/tool content plus reserve exceeds window) and is already caught by 13 broad LLMError handlers.

Adding _check_request_fit to proc with _request_text_chars and _estimate_request_tokens helpers covers first and subsequent requests identically without modifying per-op bounds or existing raise logic.
